data.description: Seed: The Step 2 audit gate (check-audit-gate.js) has no staleness awareness, unlike the Step 3.7 final-validation sweep (check-final-validation.js). Stale audits (auditedAt predates the item's last update/fix commits; baseCommit/fingerprint null) with readyToClose=false block the release immediately at exit 6, before the staleness-aware sweep can re-audit them.
